name: hexactra-console
description: An app built on the @marinoscar/platform-* packages, started from the platform starter.

scripts.setup: npm run build --workspace=cli && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js init
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @marinoscar/hexactra-agent && npm run build -w @marinoscar/hexactra-kgraph && npm run build -w @marinoscar/hexactra-browser-agent
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=mcp-ui && npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=cli && npm run build --workspace=@hexactra/console-sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=mcp-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@hexactra/console-sdk
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:packages && npm test --workspace=api && npm run test:run --workspace=web && npm run test:run --workspace=cli && npm run test:run --workspace=mcp-ui
scripts.platform:check: npm run db:check --workspace=api && npm run db:compose:check --workspace=api && platform-infra sync --check
